audit.title: Register a Custom Logic Upkeep

dimensions.name: Answer-first extractability
dimensions.analysis: Opens with a fluffy value statement — "Create powerful automation for your smart contract…" — rather than a self-contained answer. Section leads are decent ("Select **Custom Logic** trigger") but the page never states up front *what* an upkeep is or the two registration methods as a liftable summary.

dimensions.name: Structural scannability & chunkability
dimensions.analysis: Strong — 7 headings, 1 H1, max depth H3, 0 level skips, no section over 600 words (max 335). Weakness: no table summarizing the upkeep-detail fields, which is the most extractable content on the page.

dimensions.name: Concrete statistics & specifics
dimensions.analysis: Weak — 4 numerals total, 0 with units. `performGasLimit`, minimum-balance thresholds, and testnet/mainnet distinctions are referenced qualitatively; no actual gas-limit ranges, LINK minimums, or supported-network counts.

dimensions.name: Citations & authoritative references
dimensions.analysis: 13 links (11 internal, 2 external to pegswap/faucets), 0 to primary sources. Good internal cross-linking but no link to the `AutomationCompatibleInterface` source or ERC-677 spec.

dimensions.name: Quotable canonical definitions
dimensions.analysis: Weak — no crisp one-sentence definition of "custom logic upkeep," "upkeep," or "performGasLimit" near first use.

dimensions.name: Machine-readability & metadata
dimensions.analysis: 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, no datePublished/dateModified. Head metadata could not be verified from the served content — CLI should pass raw `<head>` for a full read — but no schema was present in the served HTML.

dimensions.name: Code completeness & agent-runnability
dimensions.analysis: Weakest dimension — 0 fenced code blocks. The intro promises registration "from within a contract" but provides no snippet, imports, or `registerUpkeep` call.

dimensions.name: Query/intent coverage
dimensions.analysis: Covers App-based registration only; the programmatic path is announced but absent. No troubleshooting or FAQ (e.g., "upkeep not performing," "underfunded"). Symptom-phrased retrieval is unserved.

dimensions.name: Clarity, fluency & terminology consistency
dimensions.analysis: Clear and consistent; "upkeep," "Automation," "compatible contract" used uniformly. The five undescribed image placeholders are the main clarity gap for a text-ingesting engine.

audit.summary: This is a UI-walkthrough guide for registering a custom-logic upkeep via the Chainlink Automation App. Prose is clear and terminology is consistent, but the page is heavily image-dependent (five "(Image: Image)" placeholders with no alt text or textual equivalents), carries almost no machine-readable metadata, and — despite promising registration "from within a contract that you deploy" — contains zero code. Its biggest GEO opportunity is to cover the programmatic registration path with a real snippet and to add symptom-phrased headings, both of which would win retrieval this page currently forfeits to generic ecosystem answers.

recommendations.title: Add the programmatic registration path with a runnable snippet
recommendations.where: intro promises "or from within a contract that you deploy"; no such section exists
recommendations.issue: "register it using the Chainlink Automation App or from within a contract that you deploy"
recommendations.change: Add an H2 "Register an upkeep programmatically" with a complete Solidity/ethers snippet calling `registerUpkeep` on the `AutomationRegistrar`, including imports, the registrar address, and the `RegistrationParams` struct fields.
recommendations.why: Closes the single largest coverage gap and gives agents copy-pasteable code; code-bearing pages are far more citable for "how do I register an upkeep in code" queries.

recommendations.title: Add symptom-phrased headings and a troubleshooting section
recommendations.where: end of page, after "Complete upkeep registration"
recommendations.issue: no coverage of failure states; only "If the balance drops below the **minimum balance**…"
recommendations.change: Add an H2 "Why is my upkeep not performing?" and H3s like "Upkeep underfunded / minimum balance too low," "Transaction not confirmed — gas limit exceeded," phrased as the questions devs type.
recommendations.why: Devs and agents query by symptom; concept-titled prose loses retrieval that question-phrased headings win.

recommendations.title: Lead with a canonical definition and a two-method summary
recommendations.issue: "Create powerful automation for your smart contract that leverages custom logic…"
recommendations.change: Replace with a liftable definition, e.g. "A custom logic upkeep triggers your contract's `performUpkeep` when its `checkUpkeep` function returns true. You can register one via the Chainlink Automation App or programmatically through the `AutomationRegistrar` contract."
recommendations.why: A crisp, self-contained opener is what engines lift verbatim; the marketing sentence is not.

recommendations.title: Convert the upkeep-details bullets into a specifics-rich table
recommendations.issue: field descriptions buried in prose bullets with no numeric bounds
recommendations.change: Add a table: Field | Required? | Format/limit | Notes — and fill in concrete values (e.g. Check data format `0x…` hex, gas limit bounded by `performGasLimit`, minimum starting LINK if a fixed floor exists).
recommendations.why: Tables + numbers with units are high-lift for machine extraction; the current bullets have 0 units.

recommendations.title: Provide textual equivalents for the five images
recommendations.issue: "(Image: Image)" conveys nothing to a text-ingesting engine
recommendations.change: Add descriptive captions/alt text stating what each screenshot shows (e.g. "The Register New Upkeep button in the top-right of the Automation App").
recommendations.why: Engines cannot see screenshots; undescribed images make each step non-self-contained.

recommendations.title: Add JSON-LD `TechArticle` schema, canonical URL, and a visible last-updated date
recommendations.issue: 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, no dateModified
recommendations.change: Emit `TechArticle` JSON-LD with `headline`, `dateModified`, canonical `url`, and a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: Structured metadata and freshness signals raise E-E-A-T trust and parseability. (Verify against raw `<head>` — not captured here.)

recommendations.title: Cite primary sources inline
recommendations.change: Link `AutomationCompatibleInterface` to its source/reference page and "ERC-677" to the token standard.
recommendations.why: Inline authoritative references raise citation rate.

antiPatterns: Marketing fluff opener: "Create powerful automation for your smart contract."
Undescribed image placeholders ("(Image: Image)") — content that exists only as un-ingestible screenshots.
Vague quantifiers ("Many token bridges…") with no concrete figures.
Promised-but-absent content: programmatic registration announced, never delivered.
offPageNotes: An `llms.txt` is already referenced at the top — good; confirm it lists this page.
Site-level: canonical URLs and `TechArticle` schema appear absent site-wide in served HTML; verify by passing raw `<head>` through the CLI.
Freshness cadence: no visible last-updated signal on the page; a site-wide `dateModified` convention would help all guides.
